title: The Endless Harvest
author: Elodie Thornbury
blurb: Paloma Zhou, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
